## [GitHub Releases · Crush: v0.46.0](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/tag/v0.46.0)
*GitHub Releases · Crush* | 26/02/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: api_update, product_launch, tool_update

> # Small feats Making your Thursday happier by bringing some small feats to Crush. ## More perf Our favorite contributor @acmacalister (actually, every contributor is our favorite) made yet another perf optimization for big repos. (We’re cooking more performance enhancements for the next release). ## New model: Sonnet 4.6 This was recently released by Anthropic and it's already available in Crush (even if you use an old release). ## Anthropic reasoning levels For Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, you'll now be able to choose a reasoning level. Before, this was just an on/off toggle. This thinking level is "adaptive", which means the model will skip thinking for simple prompts to avoid consuming your tokens. The higher the reasoning level, the more likely it is the model will think. ## New provider: MiniMax China Crush has been supporting MiniMax for a while. We now also support the Chinese variant, which uses a different endpoint for Chinese users. Bye bye! Charm ✨ ## Changelog ### New! * cd34bd
